_comment: Stock garak.generators.rest.RestGenerator pointed at the PwnzzAI direct prompt-injection endpoint. This demonstrates that ordinary, unmodified garak plugins reach the target -- the custom generators in garak.generators.pwnzz exist only for the surfaces REST cannot express (image upload, stateful poisoning). Run: python -m garak -t rest -G garak_conf/rest_direct_baseline.json -p promptinject -d pwnzz.CouponLeak
